problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a globally convex function f on Euclidean ℝᵈ. The objective is globally L-Lipschitz and attains its minimum.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: One query at any x ∈ ℝᵈ returns the exact value f(x) together with one subgradient. The pair costs one oracle call.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: The vector reply is a fixed selection g(x) ∈ ∂f(x), satisfying f(y) ≥ f(x) + ⟨g(x), y − x⟩ for every y. Its value depends only on x, for every query history and oracle seed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: sharpness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Writing X⋆ = argmin f and f⋆ = min f, global linear growth holds: f(x) − f⋆ ≥ μ dist(x, X⋆) for every x. The witnessing minimizer may depend on x.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SharpLipschitzConvex.lean, spec.admissible, the condition ∀ x, ∃ z, IsMinOn f Set.univ z ∧ p.μ * ‖x - z‖ ≤ f x - f z.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The Euclidean dimension satisfies d ≥ 2¹⁰ [1 + (L/μ)²(1 + log(μD/ε))]⁶ (LD/ε)², with natural logarithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The algorithm knows d, L, μ, D, ε, and x₀. Some minimizer lies within distance D of x₀. The regime is μ > 0, L ≥ 96μ, D > 0, and 0 < ε ≤ μD. The objective, a minimizer, and the minimum value are absent from the public input.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SharpLipschitzConvex.lean, Params and spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalSharpLipschitzConvex.lean, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Accuracy concerns the objective gap f(x̂) − f⋆ at the returned point x̂ ∈ ℝᵈ. The algorithm may return a point of its choice after using its oracle budget.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalSharpLipschitzConvex.lean, spec.Output and spec.successful. LongTails/Setups/SharpLipschitzConvex.lean, spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm.output and executeWithTrace.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The returned objective gap must be integrable and satisfy E[f(x̂) − f⋆] ≤ ε under the product law of the algorithm and oracle seeds. Algorithms may randomize, and the oracle reply at each fixed query is seed-independent.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SharpLipschitzConvex.lean, spec.successful and IsSubgradientOracle. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm.law and Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup specializes sharp Lipschitz convex minimization to an explicit high-dimensional regime in which the required dimension grows jointly with L/μ and the requested accuracy.
